# Names belonging to the closed deployment this runtime was extracted from.
# Already public on the published package, so committing them leaks nothing new.
# The terms that are not public live one per line in gitignored .private-terms
# and are never written down here.
# One pattern per line, and no blank lines anywhere, because a consumer that
# hands this whole file to a pattern-list flag reads an empty line as a match on
# everything. Every comment line is long and specific for the same reason.
# Two consumers read this file. One is the JavaScript RegExp constructor in
# src/__tests__/no-private-planning-refs.test.ts. The other is grep -E in
# scripts/scan-public-surfaces.sh. Every line has to be valid in both dialects,
# so use a plain capturing group and never the non-capturing kind, which is a
# JavaScript extension that GNU grep rejects outright. Spell a character class
# out in brackets rather than as a backslash shorthand, which POSIX has no
# equivalent for and which a strict engine silently matches nothing with.
# A test in that same file enforces both of those rules on every line below, so
# the next pattern added here cannot reintroduce either form.
# API feeds the closed deployment happened to call
companies-house
ch-client
epc
posthog
hogql
supabase
govuk
# its plugin and skill names
intel-(brief|scan|report)
today-aggregator
content-kanban
outreach-(drafts|generator)
collateral-(import|discover)
hypothesis-gen
experiment-checker
seo-audit
# its capability vocabulary, and the repos themselves
gsc_[A-Za-z0-9_]+
graphify
